subject: Draft MAP + request to reforecast close date / milestone reprioritization
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@orionhealthtech.com>, Elena Morris <elena@orionhealthtech.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.inference.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP + request to reforecast close date / milestone reprioritization

Hi Sam / Elena —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Per our conversation, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the Orion <> Redwood pilot. Key highlights I captured:

- Goal: Evaluate Redwood for real-time LLM inference across patient-facing workflows (rate/latency/cost)
- Proposed pilot length: 8 weeks
- Initial target close (commercial decision): 2027-06-15

Requested next steps from your side:
1) Confirm stakeholders and owners on each MAP row (I filled in the ones you mentioned)
2) Procurement timeline / PO owner (we flagged procurement might require 4–6 weeks)
3) Security evidence needed: we referenced SOC 2, privacy addendum (attached checklist)
4) Proposed POC window: May 17–June 4 (tentative)

I've attached 20270402-Orion-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx and a SOC2 checklist PDF. Please review and let me know what you'd like reprioritized. If procurement timing shifts, we can reforecast the target close — happy to adjust the MAP.

I'll follow up with Marcus (SE) and Lauren (AM) to align on technical dependencies.

Thanks,

--
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: 20270402-Orion-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, MAP rows), Orion-SOC2-Checklist.pdf (PDF)
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@orionhealthtech.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena@orionhealthtech.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 09:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + request to reforecast close date / milestone reprioritization

Camila —

Thanks for sending this over and for the clear capture. Quick update from our side after an internal roadmap sync: we need to push the procurement decision timeline out by ~6 weeks due to a conflicting compliance initiative. That means the commercial decision you have set for 2027-06-15 will likely slip.

We're still committed to evaluating Redwood, but can you do two things:
- Rebaseline the MAP with a new target close of 2027-08-01 and mark procurement as the critical path dependency.
- Move the SOC2 evidence + legal checklist up as an early milestone (we need those before the POC so our security team can sign off on the sandbox).

Also copying contracts@orionhealthtech.com — they'll want visibility on timing for SOW and any early access terms.

Can we get an updated version of the MAP by EOD Monday?

Best,
Sam
VP Product, Orion HealthTech
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@orionhealthtech.com>, Elena Morris <elena@orionhealthtech.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.inference.com, marcus_lin@redwood.inference.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + request to reforecast close date / milestone reprioritization

Hi Sam —

Appreciate the heads up. We've updated the MAP per your ask and attached a revision (v1.1). Summary of the changes I made to the milestones:

- New target commercial decision: 2027-08-01 (owner: Sam P / Contracts)
- Security intake completion (SOC2 evidence + privacy addendum): 2027-05-20 (owner: Elena M / Orion security) — marked as high priority
- Technical sandbox access & data enclave setup: 2027-05-27 (owner: Redwood / Marcus)
- POC execution window: 2027-06-01 — 2027-07-15 (owner: Orion product & Redwood SE)
- SOW & pricing finalization: 2027-07-20 (owner: Contracts)

Dependencies called out: procurement lead time (critical), internal security sign-off, and an EHR data contract that Orion legal is reviewing.

Action items for this week:
- Elena: can you confirm SOC2 evidence availability and expected handoff date (I put 2027-05-12 as tentative)
- Sam / Contracts: confirm procurement / PO owner and any preferred SOW terms
- Marcus: confirm we can provision a sandbox with the requested throughput by 2027-05-27

If this looks good I'll mark MAP v1.1 and upload to the shared Drive link and update the DocuSign placeholder for SOW routing. If you want a short sync this week to walk the updated plan, I'm available Wednesday 10–11am PT.

Thanks,

Camila
--
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: 20270405-Orion-MAP-draft-v1.1.xlsx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@orionhealthtech.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.inference.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + request to reforecast close date / milestone reprioritization

Folks — quick technical note to add to the MAP dependencies:

- Sandbox provisioning requires an approved IP allowlist + temporary service account for Oracle EHR extracts. If Orion security can provide a service account by 2027-05-15, Redwood can pre-stage the sandbox images and KV cache policies.
- If we need to support > 3 concurrent demo threads, we'll need an additional GPU slot for the sandbox during peak POC weekends (estimate incremental cost of ~$1,200/week).

I'm happy to run the POC kickoff demo the week of May 25 — Marcus (SE) calendar hold: Tue 2027-05-25 10:00–11:00 PT (invite sent).

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@orionhealthtech.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena@orionhealthtech.com>, contracts@orionhealthtech.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + request to reforecast close date / milestone reprioritization

Camila / Marcus —

Thanks — this revised plan works for us and we confirm the updated target close of 2027-08-01. Elena will lead the SOC2 evidence handoff (I copied contracts so they can see the SOW timeline).

Couple quick asks:
- Please include a short appendix in the MAP that details the proposed fallback behavior if procurement is delayed further (e.g., limited pilot scope vs delayed start).
- Can Redwood provide an abbreviated SOC2 attestation PDF and a pointer to a specific control mapping we can share with our InfoSec team?

We'll aim to have the procurement owner and PO timeline by 2027-04-12. If we meet that, the POC window you proposed is still feasible for us.

Sam
VP Product, Orion HealthTech
